Overview

About Gellhorn
International Raceway

Gellhorn International Raceway is the circuit at the center of GTA 6 Time Attack, our first lap-time competition for Grand Theft Auto VI. Every accepted lap follows one shared, versioned standard, so times stay comparable across drivers and vehicles.

The track appears in Rockstar's official gameplay footage, including a full racing HUD with lap counter, timer, and position tracker. The exact layout, length, and direction shown in unofficial leaked maps are not yet confirmed by Rockstar Games — we'll update this page with verified details once the game is out.

Standard

The Gellhorn
Standard

Every lap on this leaderboard is measured against the current Gellhorn Standard — a versioned set of rules covering accepted conditions, allowed assists, and proof requirements. The standard stays in draft until we've tested it against real gameplay, then locks in with a short provisional window after launch.
